row.title: CF-POSTURE-3: the posture reading runs on the run's OIDC identity through the deploy gateway
row.body: The repository's Cloudflare token predates the account move and is refused by the Ultrastable account, so the daily reading was unmeasured and the cost probe crashed. The deploy gateway now serves a read-only GET /posture (ids, modified time, logging setting; same OIDC check as deploys) and foundation/cfposture.py reads Workers through it when the token is refused. The cost probe records a refused token as unmeasured (COST-PROBE-3). An empty zone list from a token of another account is unmeasured, not a failure.
